role: post-test development; discriminator dropout screen after momentum study
prespecified_scope: Change only the probability of the existing discriminator Dropout layer (0 or 0.2) versus the beta1=0, dropout=0.4 controls at the identical 6000-update budget and seeds 101/202. Topology, BCE objective, learning rates, data, batch and selection remain fixed.
initial_interpretation: Two-seed 6000-update diagnostic; retain all outcomes and compare only matching budgets. Promising regularization needs a longer common budget, multiple seeds and fresh diagnostics.
decision_basis: At 30000 updates, beta1=0 gave the lowest primary error at both seeds, but diversity, peaks and ramps still missed the descriptive real-real reference. Removing/reducing heavy discriminator dropout tests an underfitting hypothesis; an improved primary score alone will not establish adequacy.
